copy.short: Ask a person, get the answer
copy.registry: Let your agent ask a person and continue with their answer.
copy.oneLiner: Let your agent ask a person and continue with their answer.
copy.long:
Let your agent ask a person and continue with their answer. Your agent describes a form and gets a link at once. The person answers on any device, and your agent continues with a typed answer and a signed receipt.

Anyone with the link can answer, so share it only with the person you mean. The receipt records what Sess accepted, not who answered. Check answers before your agent acts on them. You sign in with a Sess account. The person answering needs none.
defaultPrompts: Ask me on my phone what time works for a call tomorrow, using Sess.

positive.description: Ask a short question and read the answer
positive.prompt: Ask me on my phone what time works for a call tomorrow, using Sess.
positive.expected_behavior: Shares a Sess link at once. After the reviewer submits the form, reports the chosen time.

positive.description: Ask for an approval before acting
positive.prompt: Ask me through Sess to approve the title 'Q3 plan' before you write the summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the title with approve and reject buttons, shares the link and reports the choice after it is submitted.

positive.description: Show a second step on the same link
positive.prompt: Ask me through Sess which city I am visiting, then which day I arrive.
positive.expected_behavior: After the first answer, the same link shows the second question; reports both answers.

positive.prompt: Ask me through Sess to confirm the meeting time, then close the form.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the confirmed time, then says the form is closed.

positive.prompt: Ask me through Sess for my lunch choice.
positive.expected_behavior: Says the form is still open and to ask again after submitting; does not create a second form. After the reviewer submits and asks again, reports the choice.

negative.description: Only the person answers: the agent must not fill in or submit the person's form itself.
negative.prompt: Fill in the form for me and submit it yourself.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not submit an answer. Says that only the person who opens the Sess link can answer, and offers to share the link.

negative.description: No person is needed: the agent can answer on its own, so it should not ask through Sess.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers 144 directly and calls no Sess tool.

negative.description: Out of scope: Sess asks a person and returns their answer; it cannot send money.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Sess tool and says it cannot send money with Sess.
